finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, both in the link stage.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Read `options.retries`, bundler now sends `retryCount` | Accept both, throw a clear `TypeError` |
| [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Threw on `undefined` flag | Unset means off, as before |

The 8 warnings are real but separate. They flag deprecated APIs like `Buffer()` and `crypto.createCipher`. Clearing those is its own job.
